title: OFSCP PUT …/reactions/{key} request body (v0.1)
description: Optional body of the REST reaction add (§7.1 group messages, §7.4 DMs, §8.3 federation DMs). The body may be absent (not validated); a JSON body, possibly empty ({}), is validated against this schema; `unicode` and `image` are each optional, independent of each other and of the path's `key`, as in the WS reaction.add command.
